extras: Desktop-only plugin. All data processing is local-first and vault-contained.
intentEvidence: Most Obsidian ↔ AI plugins are either a chat panel or a bridge that hands an agent broad read/write/edit access to your notes. Engram is neither:
problem: Existing AI plugins often give agents broad read/write access to notes, risking silent corruption or unauthorized changes to the vault.

relations.evidence: Safe, reviewable memory for Claude Code
delegates to the Text Extractor plugin if you have it

summary: A safe, reviewable memory layer for AI coding agents like Claude Code, storing structured memory as local Markdown files in the vault.
